research_question: Can the actual PI and Executor exchange an approved instruction and reviewed no-op result through GitHub?
hypothesis: One approved commit is claimed once; result binds it; PI independently acknowledges the result commit.
competing_explanation: Local files or Executor-generated acknowledgement falsely appear to establish a two-sided handoff.
repeat_or_treatment: One no-op result C from a single successfully published claim B; no policy treatment.
unique_variable: One control handoff cycle; zero research/model execution.
metrics: four required outputs readable in GitHub
expected_result: A -> B -> C -> D with real PI acknowledgement, all CI checks pass.
falsifying_result: No actual PI read/approval/ack, stale or duplicate claim, missing outputs, or identity drift.
alternative_explanations: API read access does not prove PI write authority
CI passing is not PI approval
server result files alone are not GitHub handoff
stop_conditions: No PI approval or expired approval
after publishing result STOP for PI
command: print('handoff no-op; no model or episode')
